audience: IT and operations teams who monitor servers and sites with NodePing

useCases.title: See what is down or disabled right now
useCases.text: The AI reads everything that is down or disabled across the account, with the type, label and since when, and lists the checks with their pass or fail state.

useCases.title: Review a check's incidents, uptime and response times
useCases.text: The AI reads the down events of a check, its uptime per day or month, the raw results with run time and probe location, and the hourly run-time summary.

useCases.title: Review who was alerted and who gets alerts
useCases.text: The AI lists the alert notifications that were sent, the contacts and contact groups, and the notification schedules.

useCases.title: Mute, disable or change a check
useCases.text: The AI mutes a check until a time or until you unmute it, stops a check from running, or changes its label, tags, target, timeout or re-checks before an alert.

useCases.title: Create, review or delete maintenance windows
useCases.text: The AI creates a one-off maintenance window that disables the listed checks for a number of minutes, lists existing entries, or deletes one.

useCases.title: Manage contact groups and notification schedules
useCases.text: The AI creates a contact group from existing contacts, renames it or replaces its members, or creates or changes a weekday notification schedule.
